mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month and the S&P 500 still produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for three consecutive months and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls concurrently
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls concurrently and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains above 2% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and the S&P 500 still produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls concurrently
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls concurrently and the S&P 500 still produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
